children: CION Investment entered into a joint venture to sell a $180.0M fair-value portfolio of first‑lien loans and received approximately $132.3M net proceeds to repay debt.
The Joint Venture issued $125.0M of senior secured notes at 98.25% and $59.7M of LLC interests; CION holds 80% common LLC interests.
Preferred LLC interests carry an 11.50% cumulative annual dividend and priority over common distributions.
Joint Venture acquired 20 first‑lien loans from CION with aggregate par ~$180.3M and fair value $180.0M (99.8% of par).
Notes pay 3‑month SOFR + 4.75% (1.00% SOFR floor), have seven‑year maturity, investment‑grade rating and a 100% cash‑flow sweep after the 2‑year investment period.
